## Bug Fix

### Component Token Output Now Generated by CLI

`npx designerpunk generate` now produces `ComponentTokens.web.css`, `ComponentTokens.ios.swift`, and `ComponentTokens.android.kt` when component tokens are registered in the `ComponentTokenRegistry`. Previously, component token output was only generated by the internal dev script (`scripts/generate-platform-tokens.ts`), not by the CLI.

In `tokenSource` mode, `loadComponentTokens()` populates the registry before generation, so component token output is now produced alongside `DesignTokens.*` files.
